employes_email_minuscules.name: employes_email_minuscules
employes_email_minuscules.value: `employes`.`email` IS NULL OR CAST(`employes`.`email` AS BINARY) = CAST(LOWER(`employes`.`email`) AS BINARY)

employes_dates_emploi_coherentes.name: employes_dates_emploi_coherentes
employes_dates_emploi_coherentes.value: `employes`.`date_fin_emploi` IS NULL OR `employes`.`date_embauche` IS NULL OR `employes`.`date_fin_emploi` >= `employes`.`date_embauche`

employes_debut_avant_fin.name: employes_debut_avant_fin
employes_debut_avant_fin.value: `employes`.`date_fin_emploi` IS NULL OR `employes`.`date_debut_emploi` IS NULL OR `employes`.`date_fin_emploi` >= `employes`.`date_debut_emploi`

evenements_duree_coherente.name: evenements_duree_coherente
evenements_duree_coherente.value: (`evenements`.`unite_saisie` = 'heures' AND `evenements`.`duree_minutes` BETWEEN 1 AND 1440) OR (`evenements`.`unite_saisie` <> 'heures' AND `evenements`.`duree_minutes` IS NULL)

evenements_employes_heures_valides.name: evenements_employes_heures_valides
evenements_employes_heures_valides.value: (`evenements_employes`.`debut_minutes` IS NULL AND `evenements_employes`.`fin_minutes` IS NULL) OR (`evenements_employes`.`date_debut` = `evenements_employes`.`date_fin` AND `evenements_employes`.`debut_minutes` >= 0 AND `evenements_employes`.`fin_minutes` <= 1440 AND `evenements_employes`.`debut_minutes` < `evenements_employes`.`fin_minutes`)

parametres_valeur_valide.name: parametres_valeur_valide
parametres_valeur_valide.value: (`parametres`.`cle` = 'theme' AND `parametres`.`valeur` IN ('bleu', 'emeraude', 'ocean', 'ardoise', 'personnalise')) OR (`parametres`.`cle` = 'police' AND `parametres`.`valeur` IN ('hanken', 'inter', 'source_sans', 'atkinson')) OR (`parametres`.`cle` = 'taille_texte' AND `parametres`.`valeur` IN ('normale', 'grande', 'tres_grande')) OR (`parametres`.`cle` IN ('couleur_primaire', 'couleur_marine', 'couleur_accent', 'couleur_fond') AND `parametres`.`valeur` REGEXP '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$')

plages_profils_bornes.name: plages_profils_bornes
plages_profils_bornes.value: `plages_profils`.`debut_minutes` BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND `plages_profils`.`fin_minutes` BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND `plages_profils`.`fin_minutes` > `plages_profils`.`debut_minutes`

profils_horaires_repas_borne.name: profils_horaires_repas_borne
profils_horaires_repas_borne.value: (`profils_horaires`.`repas_minimum_minutes` IS NULL OR `profils_horaires`.`repas_minimum_minutes` BETWEEN 0 AND 720) AND (`profils_horaires`.`repas_maximum_minutes` IS NULL OR `profils_horaires`.`repas_maximum_minutes` BETWEEN 0 AND 720)

regles_horaires_bornes.name: regles_horaires_bornes
regles_horaires_bornes.value: `regles_horaires`.`debut_minutes` BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND `regles_horaires`.`fin_minutes` BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND `regles_horaires`.`fin_minutes` > `regles_horaires`.`debut_minutes`

utilisateurs_email_minuscules.name: utilisateurs_email_minuscules
utilisateurs_email_minuscules.value: CAST(`utilisateurs`.`email` AS BINARY) = CAST(LOWER(`utilisateurs`.`email`) AS BINARY)

utilisateurs_identifiant_minuscules.name: utilisateurs_identifiant_minuscules
utilisateurs_identifiant_minuscules.value: CAST(`utilisateurs`.`identifiant` AS BINARY) = CAST(LOWER(`utilisateurs`.`identifiant`) AS BINARY)
